decision: 10 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 6 for the 12 month period).
fact: Forcing another driver off the track.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, radio and in-car video evidence. Norris was attempting to overtake on the outside of Verstappen at Turn 4. Norris was ahead of Verstappen at the entry, apex and towards the exit of the turn when he started being forced off the track. The Stewards believe that the maneuver was done in a safe and controlled manner and that Norris would have been able to make the maneuver on the track had he not been forced off the track by Verstappen. Norris cut the corner but immediately gave the position he gained as a result back to Sainz. The penalty is the standard penalty in such cases.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 1 Turn 4 Forcing Another Driver Of The Track Corrected
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
